senses.gloss:
(I)--a pupil of बृहस्पति, a friend of कृष्ण, and a minister of वृष्णिस्. Requested by कृष्ण, he took a mes- sage to Nanda and Gopis of Vraja, where he was duly wel- comed by Nanda. The latter said that he believed with Garga, कृष्ण and राम to be gods when यशोदा narrated कृष्ण's exploits as a child. The conversation lasted all night. After his morning prayers Gopis surrounded him and asked whether कृष्ण was well and remembered them. Uddhava was struck with their devotion and told them of कृष्ण's promised visit in the near future. After spending some months when Gopis entertained him on कृष्णलीला, Uddhava left for मथुरा.
1: भा. X. ४६ (whole); ४७ (whole).
Went with कृष्ण to Sairan- dhri's house, and to अक्रूर's and returned home.
2: Ib. X. ४८. 4, १२ and ३६.
Heard the secrets of कृष्ण's self from him and was a हरिदास।
3: Ib. IX. २४. ६७; X. ४७. ५६.
Went with कृष्ण to द्वारका, and respected him by holding चामर। कृष्ण playing dice with.
4: Ib. I. 8. 7; १०. १८; १३. १६ [1]; १४. ३२; X. ६९. २०.
Consulted by him as to the method to be adopted in vanquishing जरासन्ध; sug- gested the performance of राजसूय by युधिष्ठिर and the [page१-227+ ४७] defeat of जरासन्ध resulting in the release of imprisoned kings;
5: Ib. X. ६९. २७; ७०. १५, ४५-7; ७१. 1-११; ७२. १५.
was sent in advance by राम to the Kurus to inform them of his visit.
6: Ib. X. ६८. १६.
Went to see the पाण्डवस् at उपप्ला- vyam.
7: Ib. X. ७८. [९५ (V) 3].
Honoured Nanda.
8: Ib. X. ८४. ६८.
A member of the यादव सभा। Was stationed to defend the E. gate of मथुरा when it was beseiged by जरासन्ध. Consulted by कृष्ण on the right detachment of the army.
9: Ib. X. [५२ (V) १५]; ५०. २० [2]; [५० (V) 8 & १२];
Met Vidura on the यमुना and was asked about the welfare of his kinsmen. Touched deeply by Vidura's query, Uddhava described how the Lord spent eleven years with बलराम, Gopas and Gopis, doing miracles and how he persuaded Nanda to perform गोसव। He narrated the heroic deeds of कृष्ण and the destruction of the wicked. Concluded by saying that he would reside at Badari after the यादवस् as it was the Lord's wish adding that Maitreya had been asked to be the गुरु of Vidura.
१०: Ib. III. ch. 1-4 (whole); XII. १२. 8; Vi. V. ३७. ३१-37.
Narrated to Maitreya the story of शिव destroying दक्ष's sacrifice.
११: भा. IV. 7. ६०.
Joined Yadus in defeating पौण्ड्रक.
१२: Ib. X. ६६. [2].
Saw Yadus leaving for प्रभास, and understanding कृष्ण's mind, requested him to take him also to His eternal abode. कृष्ण warned him of the advent of Kali and asked him to go about always meditating on Hari. In the course of the dialogue कृष्ण related the conversation between a Yadu and a ब्राह्- मण ascetic, laying emphasis on how the ब्राह्मण learnt lessons from earth, hill, air, sea, archer, pigeon and others and regulated life by cultivating detachment. Listened to the Lord's discourses on various spiritual topics. After being thus well instructed he made Badari his home to spend the evening of his life.
१३: Ib. XI. 6. ४०-49; XI. 7. 1-२९; ३०. 1.
As a lad of five he worshipped Hari without caring even for breakfast.
१४: Ib. III. 2. 2.
He knew the योग power of Hari.
१५: Ib. II. 7. ४५; Br. III. ३४. ४०.
Of superior भक्ति। [page१-228+ २५]
